title: ashemag/human-atlas
why_read: An open-source interactive 3D anatomy explorer built on a large public mesh dataset, useful for education and a solid demonstration of 3D web rendering at scale.
analysis: This project renders over 2,000 selectable 3D anatomical meshes from the BodyParts3D dataset in the browser, organized into system layers with search and exploded-view capabilities. Technically it demonstrates handling a large number of interactive 3D objects efficiently in a web context, likely using WebGL or Three.js, which is a nontrivial performance and UX challenge. It's useful both as an educational tool and as a reference implementation for anyone building complex 3D visualization interfaces on the web.
